Parameter.Name: Tag
Parameter.Description: The tag that marks a document as a receipt.

Parameter.Name: BatchSchedule
Parameter.Description: When the AI batch sends the waiting receipts (cron, UTC).

Parameter.Name: OcrLanguages
Parameter.Description: Tesseract languages of the receipts, e.g. deu+eng.

TermSet.Name: Tags
TermSet.Description: Tag a document to have it read as a receipt.

Term.Name: {parameter:Tag}
Term.Description: A shop receipt: read by AI in the batch window.

Term.Name: Warranty
Term.Description: Kept with a receipt; not read.

ContentType.Name: Receipt
ContentType.Description: A photo or PDF of a receipt, read by AI.

Workspace.Name: {parameter:Workspace}
Workspace.Description: Receipts read by AI: tag a photo or PDF with "{parameter:Tag}".

w:Workflow.Name: Read receipts
w:Workflow.Description: Reads a receipt in the AI batch when it is tagged, or when a file uploaded with the tag is processed.
